Market today: Mixed mood. Rebounding Treasury yields and JPMorgan's warning on higher bond yields are the real drivers, creating headwinds for your growth-oriented tech/chip names.

Your holdings: SOXL (-52.56%) and SPAL (-40%) are leveraged and deeply in the red, amplifying risk on margin. SMH (-11.86%) and QQQI (-3.67%) are also marked TRIM and still down.

Watch: Closely monitor Treasury yields for continued upward pressure. Also, keep a tight watch on your leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) given their volatility and current drawdowns.

Bottom line: Keep a close eye on bond yields and your leveraged positions; they're the biggest risks right now.
plays: SOXL is a SELL at -52.56%. Given its leveraged decay and deep loss, consider reducing exposure now to manage risk.
SPAL is a new, leveraged position down -40%. Volatility and margin amplify drops; consider if this risk aligns with your book.
SMH is marked TRIM at -11.86%. With chip names under pressure, consider reducing this position to manage sector concentration.
